title: Store a timestamp with each saved greeting
body:
Every greeting appended to greetings.txt must be prefixed with the save time in the format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm followed by a single space, for example 2026-09-07 14:30 Hello, World!.
The history shown at startup must display the timestamp before each greeting. Lines already stored without a timestamp (the current format) must still be read and displayed as they are, so existing files keep working.
The clock must be injectable so the Spock spec can assert an exact timestamp.
